title: Magnetic Aura/Skill history

{{Skill history}}

== [[Feedback:Game updates/20120913|September 13, 2012]] ==
*Increased cost to 10 Energy; increased casting time to 1 second; reduced recharge to 12 seconds; changed functionality to: "For 1...5 seconds, you block the next attack against you and deal 10...50 damage to your attacker. If you are Overcast, all party members in earshot are also enchanted."
